name: leadflow-backup-sheets
description: Isolated toolkit: logs backup manifests and exports minimized, read-only business-data snapshots to Google Sheets as a secondary, human-readable record. Never a substitute for the Cloudflare R2 PostgreSQL dumps. Deliberately dependency-light (no Google SDK) — a hand-rolled JWT signer + fetch keeps the supply-chain surface small for a script that handles a service-account key.
